request.subject: UNIT:DWARF:KNIGHT

layers.text: Add only one thing: one small round bright signal-green lamp, colour #2bd94a with a white #e8ffe8 glint, about three pixels wide, set in a little copper ring on the front of the iron dome below the hatch. Do not change anything else: keep the soot-black iron dome, the copper band, the wheels, the cannon snout, the smokestack and its white steam, the dwarf in the hatch, the shapes, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
